items.name: narration_en
items.direction: Narrate this for a premium documentary YouTube Shorts channel about money, history and the tricks behind them. The Narrator is a deep, warm, confident storyteller with a hint of mystery: curious, quietly amused, energetic and punchy, never slow, never announcer-like. Natural emphasis on dates and numbers, questions end with a curious lift, a short comic pause before each punchline. Keep the same voice, pace and energy from start to finish. Chars voices two funny cartoon characters (a smug gold bar and a nervous banknote), short and punchy, performed exactly as described in each bracket.
lines: Narrator
Americans lost over seven billion dollars to crypto scams last year. Many begin with a wrong-number text. Would you reply?
Narrator
A friendly stranger. Weeks of chats. Then your savings are gone.
Narrator
Scammers call it pig butchering. First, they fatten the pig.
Chars
[smug, deep, rich gold bar, very pleased with himself] Charming name. Very professional.
Narrator
So how do they fatten you?
Narrator
They're patient. Daily chats. A friendship. Maybe romance.
Narrator
Then a tip: a crypto app where they're making a fortune.
Narrator
You invest a little. The app shows huge profits. You even withdraw some.
Narrator
And that's exactly when it turns.
Narrator
You invest more. To cash out, there's suddenly a "tax" to pay first.
Narrator
That's the mirage: the profits were just numbers on a fake app.
Narrator
Days ago, US prosecutors charged a ring whose workers got bonuses for stealing more.
Chars
[nervous, squeaky banknote, trembling] They had performance reviews?
Narrator
So if a friendly stranger wants to teach you investing... you're the pig.
Narrator
Comment: ever got a wrong-number text?
Narrator
This is Money Mirage. Follow for more.
